newsitem.title: USA: Multimedia Games completes equity offer.
newsitem.headline: Multimedia Games completes equity offer.

text.p: Multimedia Games Inc said Wednesday it completed the previously disclosed private placement of about 1.2 million shares of common stock for roughly $3.5 million.
Each share sold in the placement was accompanied by a warrant to purchase another share of common stock for $8.00.

The warrants are redeemable for $0.10 each once the company's common stock has maintained a closing price of at least $12 a share for 20 consecutive trading days. The warrants cannot be exercised prior to August 12, 1997.
Net cash proceeds from the placment excluding the conversion to equity of $800,000 in bridge debt financing, will be about $2.2 million.
Cash proceeds are intended to finance the expansion of the company's MegaMania network, Multimedia said.
Multimedia Games, through its MegaBingo Inc subsidiary, has exclusive contracts with more than 50 Indian nations to provde linked games that are integrated among multiple halls.
